segments.say: Ben swallowed a giant laser blast, and then he gave it *back*.
Ben Tennyson is fifteen, and a strange watch just locked onto his *wrist*.
It turns him into aliens, and a giant bounty hunter named *Kraab* wants that watch.
Kraab grabs Ben's cousin Gwen, and she *punches* him in the face.
Then Gwen goes missing, and Ben finds her phone on the *ground*.
Kraab yells, come out, kid! I am done waiting on this stinky *planet*.
Ben thinks, maybe I am the *help*.
Kraab fires a giant laser, and Ben slams the watch and vanishes in the *smoke*.
This time he is a black alien with long *cables* for arms.
Kraab throws Ben around like a toy, and stabs his own cable into *him*.
Then he electrocutes him, and Ben is *losing*.
Meanwhile Gwen escapes a burning cabin with magic nobody knew she *had*.
Kraab sees her running, and aims right at *her*.
Ben screams no, and his cables catch the *blast*.
The full story is on our channel.
